issues.location: interpretation of arithmetic language in the nonstandard model
issues.finding: The proof names the language L rather than the previously defined L_N, calls all nonlogical symbols constants, and writes M squared for the domain of the order relation.
issues.proposed_resolution: Use L_N, call these nonlogical symbols, and write Domain(M) squared for the order relation in the Javanese target.

issues.finding: After ruling out x-star equals y, the proof repeats the original x less than y claim rather than concluding x-star less than y.
issues.proposed_resolution: Conclude that x-star is less than y.

issues.finding: The standard block has a least element and order type omega, so it is not a doubly infinite Z-chain; only nonstandard blocks have the stated two-sided form.
issues.proposed_resolution: Restrict the Z-chain statement to nonstandard blocks.

issues.location: strict ordering induced on equivalence classes
issues.finding: x less than y does not imply the block of x is strictly less than the block of y when x and y lie in the same block.
issues.proposed_resolution: State the strict block comparison only for elements in distinct blocks.

translation_treatment: The target makes these bounded corrections while preserving the source's model construction, exercises, and formula order. The frozen English bytes remain unchanged.
